final: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS average_amount FROM trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_average FROM account_averages) SELECT a.account_id, a.average_amount, a.average_amount - o.mean_average AS above_mean FROM account_averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE a.average_amount > o.mean_average ORDER BY above_mean DESC, a.account_id LIMIT 10
